description: This file defines a NotesApi class that provides methods to interact with notes data on a remote server, including listing, upserting, and deleting notes via HTTP requests.

classes.name: NotesApi
classes.description: A class that acts as a client for notes-related API endpoints, providing methods to retrieve, create/update, and delete notes.

methods.name: listNotes
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of notes from the server. Handles JSON response and filters for list of dictionaries.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Creates or updates a note on the server by sending JSON data via POST request.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from the server based on its remote ID.
